items.title: Reduce Amazon DynamoDB backup storage costs with incremental backups in AWS Backup
items.summary: AWS Backup now offers incremental backups for Amazon DynamoDB, storing only the changes after the first full backup instead of a complete copy each time. Learn how incremental backups work, how to set them up in the AWS Backup console, how they support ransomware recovery with logically air-gapped vaults, and how pricing works.
items.creator: Timothy Chappell

items.title: Build cost-effective semantic search for documents stored in Amazon S3
items.summary: Organizations accumulate vast amounts of unstructured data (contracts, research papers, support tickets, and regulatory filings), yet much of it remains hard to search effectively. Traditional keyword search may miss a document about “intellectual property transfer” when the query is “patent assignment clauses,” because it matches the search terms rather than their meaning.
